page.layout: One printed page: a copperplate title page with engravings. Top: a wide engraved panel (Paradise scene with a Hebrew word above). Middle: three panels, left engraving, centre text block, right engraving. Bottom: a wide engraved panel with two men carrying a bunch of grapes. Text is only in the centre block and the Hebrew line above it, read top to bottom.
page.notes: The Hebrew line is printed above the centre block and is transcribed as printed. The top engraving carries a small Hebrew word (יהוה) at upper right; the right-hand engraving carries the same. The bottom engraving has engraver's signatures at lower left and lower centre ("J. v. Meris delin." and "Fr. Mannik fecit sculp." as far as legible), which are not transcribed as text. The engravings are described only: no printed text otherwise. Letter forms of the centre block are copied as seen; the Latin with v/u and i/j is normalised per the rules above. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
